title: Bulacan emergency contacts and evacuation facilities — sourced starter directory

verification_policy.meaning: official_publication_found means a government source names the contact or facility. It does not mean a phone is reachable, a shelter is safe/open, or a location was field-verified.
verification_policy.source_checked_at_meaning: Date the publication was researched; never substitute for status_checked_at.
verification_policy.geocoding_policy: No guessed or barangay-centroid pins. Ten original official-plan coordinates retained; nine additional public mapped facility/grounds positions matched to official designation/use. Public map coordinates are not an official location survey. Unresolved candidates must not be rendered.
verification_policy.capacity_policy: Plan figures are historical estimates, not available beds. Never subtract unknown occupancy from these figures.
verification_policy.completeness: Emergency directory covers 24 LGUs; named shelter coverage is partial. This research does not establish all facilities or all official sources.

import_guidance.format: One JSON object; import evacuation_centers and emergency_contacts as separate collections. Resolve each source_ids value against sources[].id.
import_guidance.seed_behavior: Idempotent upsert by id; preserve admin-created records and admin overrides. Store source data separately from live operational data.
import_guidance.unknown_status_display: Opening status unconfirmed — contact the local DRRMO.
import_guidance.missing_coordinates: Show in directory; omit map marker and navigation until exact location is confirmed. Never coerce null to zero.
import_guidance.conflicts: Prefer dated local authority updates over undated provincial-directory listings, preserving both provenance and superseded values.
import_guidance.hotline_display: Label undated contacts as needing reconfirmation. Do not call every number verified active. Click-to-call only when tel_uri is present.
import_guidance.refresh: Record future source refreshes and activation updates with separate timestamps. A static seed cannot automatically keep service status current.
import_guidance.deduplication: Review Angat San Roque barangay site versus Municipal Evacuation Center compound. Do not merge facilities merely because coordinates or barangay match.
import_guidance.scope: Do not broaden scope beyond Bulacan; 911 is retained because Bulacan PDRRMO itself publishes it.
import_guidance.repo_integration: Inspect the current Flood Watch schema and UI before writing a migration. No compatibility with an unseen schema is claimed.
import_guidance.location_update: Merge location fields for existing stable IDs; preserve newer admin locations and all operational statuses. Read location_source_ids and coordinate_precision. Never promote coordinate_candidate to a map pin automatically.
import_guidance.map_attribution: For OSM-derived coordinates, preserve attribution: © OpenStreetMap contributors, https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright (ODbL). Public-map source records identify Mapcarta as presentation source. Keep Waze attribution for the Patubig place-code source. Review applicable map-data terms for reuse.

Some government pages publish legacy numbers. No missing landline digits or prefixes were guessed.
Construction budgets and proposed projects were not treated as completed evacuation centers.
24 facilities remain without coordinates. Two community-directory candidates are retained separately for review and must not be shown as pins.
Public mapped positions may be stale and identify grounds rather than exact evacuation buildings or entrances.
Original ten Malolos plan coordinates were preserved and were not re-surveyed in this update.
Sapang Bayan BMLTC incident label may name evacuee origin. TESDA identifies the facility campus at Arce Street, Poblacion.

location_update.meaning: Nine facility/grounds locations matched online. Public-map evidence is distinguished from official designation evidence; none are field verified or confirmed open.
